verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a dispute-management process it facilitates step-by-step, and it ships agent tooling (the AgentOS MCP server and a CLI that exposes a broad slice of the API in production). However, nothing in the evidence shows dispute endpoints, evidence submission via API, or dispute coverage in the CLI, MCP or AgentOS skills, so the end-to-end agent flow is only implied. Missing for 10: documented dispute retrieval/list API, evidence upload and response submission endpoints, dispute tools in the MCP/CLI or an AgentOS dispute skill, and any hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a dispute.
